keys.expirationHint: After that, the key can no longer enroll a machine. Already enrolled machines are not affected.
keys.issuedTitle: Key issued, hand it over now
keys.issuedWarning: This key will never be shown again once closed. It works only once.
keys.command: Command to run on the machine

commandHint.windows: In PowerShell run as administrator. Installs Tailscale, then enrolls the station.
commandHint.linux: Installs Tailscale with the official script, then enrolls the machine (sudo required).
commandHint.installed: Tailscale must already be installed; the command enrolls the machine with this key.
commandHint.agent: On the machine (Debian, Ubuntu, Raspberry Pi OS), with sudo: installs Tailscale, joins the fleet and installs the Stramscale agent, which immediately sends its specs and packages.

keys.machineNameHint: Otherwise the machine keeps its hostname.
